name: Quadratic equation calculation produces correct real roots and step-by-step solution
description: When a user inputs quadratic coefficients a=1, b=-7, and c=12, the application automatically computes delta=1 and roots x1=4 and x2=3 with didactic step-by-step breakdown.

planSteps.description: Clear the input field for coefficient a and type 1
Clear the input field for coefficient b and type -7
Clear the input field for coefficient c and type 12
Verify the calculation result displays roots x₁ = 4 and x₂ = 3 with positive discriminant delta = 1 in the solution card
